services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Upstairs Artspace welcomes the opportunity to rent its galleries for private and public events. In most cases, the exhibitions that are on the walls at the time of the event will remain in place during the renter's event. The entire gallery can accommodate 350 people at one time. We have a small kitchen, four bathrooms, 55 chairs, and several folding tables available. Please note that the lower gallery is not handicap accessible. A party may rent the upstairs level, downstairs, or both.
